acts.title: Opening the curtain
acts.play_cue: Press Play. Test Pause, resume and Stop during the narration.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Welcome to the Book of Hosts theatre. Tonight, a sealed letter has vanished from the locked study. Test pause, play, and the talking portrait. When I finish, the host will reveal the first clue.

steps.title: The silver thread
steps.text: A silver thread lies below the study window. Show this clue to your guests. Nothing plays until the host continues.

steps.speaker: test-jester
steps.text: A silver thread was found beside the window. Give your guests time to investigate. The next scene will wait for the host to continue.

steps.prompt: Stop here. Let players discuss the clue, then choose Next scene.

steps.text: Host music cue: play your chosen interval music separately. Continue when ready.
Rehearsal mini-game: each guest describes one suspicious object without naming it. Other guests guess. The host decides when to finish.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: The letter was hidden inside the magician’s hat. This rehearsal is complete. Every investigation stop waited for the host. Your own narrator recordings can replace this simple test voice.

steps.prompt: Curtain call. The rehearsal is complete.
